description: Provider-neutral VibeOS model and effort policy. Tiers resolve at runtime; this file intentionally avoids hardcoded current model IDs.

drafting.purpose: Low-risk prose, summaries, and documentation cleanup.
drafting.resolution_strategy: Prefer the cheapest locally available model that can follow project instructions.

implementation.purpose: General code changes, tests, scripts, and bounded harness work.
implementation.resolution_strategy: Prefer the current balanced coding model alias; escalate when the WO class or audit findings require it.

frontier-audit.purpose: High-risk architecture, security, correctness, invariant, red-team, and release-proof audits.
frontier-audit.resolution_strategy: Resolve to the strongest locally available audit model alias; never silently downgrade audit-class work.

dependency-research.purpose: Current-source package, SDK, framework, security, compatibility, and upgrade-path research.
dependency-research.resolution_strategy: Use current documentation evidence and the strongest economical model alias that can reason over compatibility constraints.

cost-sensitive.purpose: Repeatable low-risk checks where cost control matters more than frontier reasoning.
cost-sensitive.resolution_strategy: Prefer a low-cost model alias and keep output structured for downstream deterministic gates.

haiku.runtime_resolution: Claude Code model alias or runtime default equivalent

sonnet.runtime_resolution: Claude Code model alias or runtime default equivalent

opus.runtime_resolution: Claude Code model alias or runtime default equivalent

codex_mapping.rule: Codex mappings must resolve from local runtime capabilities and must not claim Claude hook or model parity.

public_limitations: Tier names are policy contracts, not pinned provider model IDs.
Runtime detection decides what is locally available before orchestration claims are made.
ConfigChange downgrade blocking applies to Claude Code hook events only; Codex hook parity is not claimed.
Cost reports parsed from headless output are estimates and must be reconciled against provider billing before public claims.
